{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check: are there six QA orders with revenue 999999.99?
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# The contract says population is ALL orders, so we must include them.
# Compute conversion rate by channel including all orders
conversion_rates_all = df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
e_email_all = conversion_rates_all['email']
e_paid_search_all = conversion_rates_all['paid_search']
diff_all = e_email_all - e_paid_search_all

print(f'Email conversion rate (all orders): {e_email_all:.4f}')
print(f'Paid search conversion rate (all orders): {e_paid_search_all:.4f}')
print(f'Difference (email - paid_search) (all orders): {diff_all:.4f}')"}
